summary.text: Kyle Green is a Democrat member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 83, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Jefferson Parish. First elected in 2019, Kyle Green chairs the Democratic Caucus and sits on the Commerce, Insurance, and Judiciary committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Kyle Green's occupation as attorney, with a degree from Archbishop Shaw High School (2005), a B.A. in political science from Southern University (2009), and a J.D. from Southern University Law Center (2015).

The House page lists Kyle Green's committee assignments as Commerce, Insurance, Judiciary, House Executive Committee, and Capitol Security Council, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Democratic Caucus (chair), Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus.
